discrimination_wording: Threshold-independent discrimination is reported using ROC-AUC. Threshold-dependent operating performance is reported separately using held-out balanced accuracy, sensitivity and specificity.
high_threshold_note: An unusually high decision threshold (for example above 0.90) indicates that the raw fake_score distribution for this configuration/dataset is shifted toward the fake token. Adjusting the threshold changes only the operating point on that score axis; it does not improve ROC-AUC or the underlying ranking of samples. Justification for such a threshold rests on validation selection plus held-out behaviour and remains dataset/application-specific — not a universally appropriate setting.
